sentences.text: ANLEGGSDELER AS is a private limited company (AS), registered in Hustadvika, founded 2021-08-20.
The register shows no bankruptcy, liquidation or forced dissolution.
Its registered industry is engroshandel med maskiner og utstyr ellers.
The registry describes its activity as: “Engroshandel med maskiner og utstyr til handel, transport og tjenesteyting ellers.”.
Its own website describes it as: “Din leverandør av deler til anleggsmaskiner, olje, anleggsdekk, utstyr og tilbehør.” (company-reported).
Filed accounts for the period ending 2025-12-31 show revenue of NOK 23.4 m and a net result of NOK 2.4 m.
Revenue fell 19.3% from NOK 29.0 m in 2024 to NOK 23.4 m in 2025.
The net result fell from NOK 6.4 m to NOK 2.4 m.
Equity was NOK 8.9 m at the end of 2025, 25% of total assets.
The registry reports 5 employees.
Key registered roles — Daglig leder: Richard Wenaas Naas; Styrets leder: Lars Gunnar Hage.
The board has 4 registered members including the chair.
Its auditor is TFO REVISJON & RÅDGIVNING AS; its accountant is AKTUELT REGNSKAP AS.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-01-22.
Its verified website is https://www.anleggsdeler.no/.
Company-owned profiles linked from that site: facebook, instagram.

sentences.text: DATA NOVA AS is a private limited company (AS), registered in Oslo, founded 1994-01-11.
The register shows no bankruptcy, liquidation or forced dissolution.
Its registered industry is utgivelse av annen programvare.

The registry describes its activity as: “Utvikle og markedsføre totale IT-løsninger for detaljhandel i inn- og utland. Selskapet kan delta i annen virksomhet, herunder import og eksport, gjennom eget eller andre selskap. Selskapet kan besitte fast eiendom.”.
Its own website describes it as: “Vi effektiviserer din digitale hverdag med innovative og sikre forretningssystemer – noe vi har brent for i over 30 år.” (company-reported).
Filed accounts for the period ending 2025-12-31 show revenue of NOK 73.7 m and a net result of NOK 9.5 m.
Revenue rose 3.5% from NOK 71.2 m in 2024 to NOK 73.7 m in 2025.
The net result fell from NOK 11.4 m to NOK 9.5 m.
Equity was NOK 28.5 m at the end of 2025, 49% of total assets.
The registry reports 30 employees.
Key registered roles — Daglig leder: Hanne Valen-Sendstad; Styrets leder: Vimal Kumar Badhwar.
The board has 2 registered members including the chair.
Its auditor is PKF REVISJON AS.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-09-28.
Its verified website is https://www.datanova.no/.
Company-owned profiles linked from that site: linkedin.
Its site has a careers page: https://www.datanova.no/jobb.

sentences.text: VIKEN VEI OG ANLEGG AS is a private limited company (AS), registered in Ås, founded 2019-06-18.
The register shows no bankruptcy, liquidation or forced dissolution.
Its registered parent is VIKEN ENTREPRENØR AS (100%).
Its registered industry is grunnarbeid.

Filed accounts for the period ending 2025-12-31 show revenue of NOK 11.4 m and a net loss of NOK 4.5 m.

The net result rose from a loss of NOK 4.9 m to a loss of NOK 4.5 m.
Equity was negative (NOK -8.1 m) at the end of 2025.
Key registered roles — Daglig leder: Andreas Nikolai Nilsen; Styrets leder: Dagfinn Lindberg.
Its auditor is RE-VISJON AS.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2025-10-22.

sentences.text: PLOREA HOLDING AS is a private limited company (AS), registered in Trondheim, founded 2019-08-14.
The register shows no bankruptcy, liquidation or forced dissolution.
Its registered industry is dataprogrammeringstjenester.

Its own website describes it as: “Join 2000+ businesses using Plorea's POS, ecommerce, payments & integrations. Scalable solutions for retail, restaurants, hotels & more across Scandinavia.” (company-reported).
Filed accounts for the period ending 2025-12-31 show revenue of NOK 543 k and a net loss of NOK 12.4 m.

Equity was NOK 63.2 m at the end of 2025, 76% of total assets.
Key registered roles — Styrets leder: Ståle Risa.
The board has 4 registered members including the chair.
Its auditor is BDO AS; its accountant is FRISIKT VEST AS.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-06-30.
Its verified website is https://plorea.com/.
Its site has a careers page: https://plorea.com/career.

sentences.text: TAK & METALL AS is a private limited company (AS), registered in Tromsø, founded 1994-06-13.
The register shows no bankruptcy, liquidation or forced dissolution.
Its registered industry is engroshandel med metaller og metallholdig malm.

The registry describes its activity as: “Agentur og salgsvirksomhet innen bygg- og metall- bransjen og hva dermed står i forbindelse. Selskapet kan også delta med aksjer eller eier- andel i andre selskaper med økonomisk formål.”.
Filed accounts for the period ending 2025-12-31 show revenue of NOK 26.8 m and a net result of NOK 189 k.
Revenue rose 3.7% from NOK 25.8 m in 2024 to NOK 26.8 m in 2025.
The net result rose from NOK 143 k to NOK 189 k.
Equity was NOK 16.4 m at the end of 2025, 81% of total assets.
The registry reports 11 employees.
Key registered roles — Daglig leder: Guro Merete Kasbergsen; Styrets leder: Frank-Einar Lieng.
The board has 6 registered members including the chair.
Its auditor is REVISORKOMPANIET TROMSØ AS.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-02-10.

sentences.text: SONDRE DØLI HOLDING AS is a private limited company (AS), registered in Skien, founded 2013-03-18.
The register shows no bankruptcy, liquidation or forced dissolution.
Its registered industry is utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom.

Filed accounts for the period ending 2025-12-31 show revenue of NOK 191 k and a net result of NOK 414 k.

Equity was NOK 2.7 m at the end of 2025, 10% of total assets.

sentences.text: OSLOFJORDENS FRILUFTSRÅD is a association (FLI), registered in Asker, founded 1933-11-23.
The register shows no bankruptcy, liquidation or forced dissolution.
Its registered industry is aktiviteter i andre medlemsorganisasjoner ellers.

The registry describes its activity as: “Frivillig samarbeidsorgan for kommuner og fylker, samt foreninger og organisasjoner, for forvaltning av friluftsressurser, fremme av friluftslivet og vern av natur ved Oslofjorden.”.
Its own website describes it as: “Oslofjordens Friluftsråd er en ideell organisasjon som arbeider for en ren Oslofjord i økologisk balanse, som er tilgjengelig for friluftsliv.” (company-reported).
Filed accounts for the period ending 2025-12-31 show revenue of NOK 79.9 m and a net result of NOK 1.4 m.
Revenue rose 14.7% from NOK 69.7 m in 2024 to NOK 79.9 m in 2025.
The net result fell from NOK 3.2 m to NOK 1.4 m.
Equity was NOK 23.3 m at the end of 2025, 58% of total assets.
The registry reports 55 employees.
Key registered roles — Daglig leder: Espen Søilen; Styrets leder: Øivind Sjuls.
The board has 8 registered members including the chair.
Its auditor is PKF REVISJON AS.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-09-28.
Its verified website is https://www.oslofjorden.org/.
Company-owned profiles linked from that site: instagram.
The latest dated item on its site is “Håøya” (2026-09-25).

sentences.text: H - VINDUET FJERDINGSTAD AS is a private limited company (AS), registered in Øvre Eiker, founded 2009-06-23.
The register shows no bankruptcy, liquidation or forced dissolution.
Its registered industry is produksjon av dører og vinduer i tre.
The registry describes its activity as: “Produksjon og salg av vinduer, dører og andre bygningsartikler, samt hva hermed står i forbindelse, herunder deltakelse i andre selskaper.”.
Filed accounts for the period ending 2025-12-31 show revenue of NOK 405.6 m and a net loss of NOK 3.6 m.
Revenue rose 10.9% from NOK 365.8 m in 2024 to NOK 405.6 m in 2025.
The net result fell from NOK 5.0 m to a loss of NOK 3.6 m.
Equity was NOK 237.1 m at the end of 2025, 69% of total assets.
The registry reports 74 employees.
Key registered roles — Daglig leder: Knut Einar Fjerdingstad; Styrets leder: Tore Gulliksen.
The board has 6 registered members including the chair.
Its auditor is ØSTLANDSKE REVISORER AS.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2025-11-17.

sentences.text: HAKO NORWAY AS is a private limited company (AS), registered in Lillestrøm, founded 1981-07-14.
The register shows no bankruptcy, liquidation or forced dissolution.
Its registered industry is engroshandel med maskinverktøy.

The registry describes its activity as: “Salg, montering og service av maskiner, lasteramper, værtetningsporter og andre energi- sparende og miljøforbedrende utstyr for industri og offentlige virksomheter, samt ved aksjetegning eller på annen måte å gjøre seg interessert i andre f”.
Filed accounts for the period ending 2025-12-31 show revenue of NOK 67.8 m and a net loss of NOK 8.9 m.
Revenue fell 17.8% from NOK 82.4 m in 2024 to NOK 67.8 m in 2025.
The net result fell from a loss of NOK 1.1 m to a loss of NOK 8.9 m.
Equity was NOK 9.8 m at the end of 2025, 25% of total assets.
The registry reports 18 employees.
Key registered roles — Daglig leder: Hans Arne Eliassen; Styrets leder: Frank Michael Ulbricht.
The board has 3 registered members including the chair.
Its auditor is TRAN REVISJON AS; its accountant is WEPE REGNSKAP AS.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-04-13.

Its accountant is FRISIKT VEST AS.
